carol: js-lint failure looks like a pre-commit rule violation in services/auth. not a flaky test.

ben: integration rerun started — watching logs. if it flakes we'll rerun again but lint needs a patch.

```

Error: Request timed out after 30s
```

```
services/auth/index.js

```

dave: propose plan: 1) revert the trivial eslint change (or fix quickly) in a patch PR, 2) rerun integration once lint passes, 3) if integration still flakes, pin to previous stable tag v2.13.9 for the release window.

alice: agreed. I'll open the lint fix PR now and request quick review. cc @carol

carol: review incoming. small fix, will approve in a few.

ben: integration rerun queued after PR merge. also scheduling a retry for job 8342 once CI sees the new commit.

ben: if lint PR merges in next 10m, we can re-run full CI. otherwise we should pin and rollback plan ready.

alice: PR opened: https://git.company/repo/pull/482 — fix eslint unused var in services/auth. small patch.

carol: approved + merged. build triggered.

deploybot: CI gate update: js-lint -> passed, integration-tests (job 8342) retried -> running

alice: will watch errors and latency dashboards. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround :purple_heart:

dave: adding post-mortem note: flaky integration test timeout — create follow-up ticket to increase test stability/timeouts or mock external dependency.
